title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Intelligence and Reasoning - Direction Sense
subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: Alex starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 17 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only, unless specified.)
questions.explain:
Let Point A be (0,0). 
1. Drives 8 km East → Current position (8, 0).
2. Takes a left turn (faces North) and drives 6 km → Current position (8, 6).
3. Takes a left turn (faces West) and drives 17 km → $(8 - 17, 6) = (-9, 6)$.
4. Takes a left turn (faces South) and drives 13 km → $(-9, 6 - 13) = (-9, -7)$.
5. Takes a final left turn (faces East) and drives 9 km → $(-9 + 9, -7) = (0, -7)$. This is Point P.
To return to Point A (0,0) from P (0,-7), Alex needs to drive 7 km North.

questions.q: Ajay starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, then turns left and drives 7 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degrees turns only, unless specified.)
questions.explain:
Let Point A be origin (0,0).
1. West 16 km → (-16, 0)
2. Right (North) 8 km → (-16, 8)
3. Left (West) 7 km → (-23, 8)
4. Left (South) 8 km → (-23, 0)
5. Final right turn (West) 2 km → (-25, 0). This is point P.
To return to Point A (0,0) from P (-25, 0), he must drive 25 km towards the East.
